SELECT f.sample_id AS sampleId, f.subbarcode AS subbarcode, MAX(f.project_no) AS projectNo, MAX(f.order_code) AS orderCode, MAX(f.product_bio) AS productBio, MAX(f.research_center) AS researchCenter, COUNT(*) AS fileTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN f.backup_status IN (2, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fileDone, SUM(CASE WHEN f.backup_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fileFailed, SUM(CASE WHEN f.backup_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fileSkipped, COALESCE(SUM(f.file_size), 0) AS totalBytes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.backup_status = 2 THEN f.file_size ELSE 0 END), 0) AS backedBytes, MAX(f.backup_time) AS lastBackupAt, AS backupStatus FROM backup_sample_file f WHERE f.del_flag = '0'
AND f.subbarcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.subbarcode}, '%')
AND f.project_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.projectNo}, '%')
AND f.order_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.orderCode}, '%')
AND f.product_bio = #{bo.productBio}
AND f.create_time >= CONCAT(#{bo.beginDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND f.create_time <= CONCAT(#{bo.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY f.sample_id, f.subbarcode
HAVING backupStatus = #{bo.backupStatus}
ORDER BY lastBackupAt DESC, f.sample_id DESC

SELECT f.id AS id, f.report_id AS reportId, f.file_category AS fileCategory, f.file_name AS fileName, f.server_host AS serverHost, f.server_path AS serverPath, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.file_md5 AS fileMd5, f.oss_path AS ossPath, f.oss_meta_md5 AS ossMetaMd5, f.backup_status AS backupStatus, f.backup_time AS backupTime, f.fail_reason AS failReason FROM backup_sample_file f WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY f.file_category, f.file_name
SELECT DISTINCT f.product_bio FROM backup_sample_file f WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.product_bio IS NOT NULL AND f.product_bio != '' ORDER BY f.product_bio
